method: Describe independent start/middle/finish race-clock measurement in the final video's actual frames, including any clip/record mapping evidence.

video_to_clip.method: Measure video PTS to native clip time using actual rendered markers and pin the diagnostic video, marker-frame images, clean/clock clip equivalence and readback inspections.

record_to_race.method: Corroborate the preserved record clock against original race-time actions and actual native race timer/vehicle positions; a serialized zero offset alone is insufficient.

observation_window.method: Measure the first and last usable actual native frames and inspect visibility across the entire interval. Retain any unobserved original race prefix/suffix and all raw controls explicitly; never substitute generated or repeated frames.
